summary.text: David Whitaker represents District 22 in the Arkansas House of Representatives, which includes part of Washington County, and has served in the House since 2013, including as Minority Leader in 2017.

paragraphs.text: Whitaker graduated cum laude from the University of Mary Washington and earned a J.D. from the University of Arkansas School of Law in Fayetteville. He served as a staff sergeant in the U.S. Air Force.
